title: Lobbying Explorer
subtitle: Who registered to lobby Massachusetts state government, on what, and for whom — as they reported it to the Secretary of the Commonwealth.

banner.feedback: The lobbying explorer is in beta. Send feedback to

misc.viewOnSosLabel: View the original on the MA Secretary of State's website
misc.filesThroughFirm: {{name}} doesn't file lobbying disclosures directly; the entity that employs them reports this work. See its page for bills and clients.

explainers.bills: Bills that at least one registered lobbyist reported working on.
explainers.clients: Organizations that hired a lobbyist or lobbying firm, or lobbied through their own staff.
explainers.firms: Individual lobbyists and lobbyist entities (firms and organizations that employ lobbyists) registered with the MA Secretary of State.
explainers.spendNotReported: Spending isn't shown for {{years}}: disclosures from those years don't report compensation by client.

attribution: Data from the MA Secretary of State Lobbyist Public Search.

activity.noClientNote: Not an organization: lobbyists who reported no client
activity.positionsNote: Positions are each lobbyist's own statement on their filing.

overview.defBills: Bill numbers that appear in at least one lobbyist's activity report in {{where}}.
overview.defClients: Organizations that hired a lobbyist or lobbying firm, or lobbied through their own staff, in {{where}}.
overview.defLobbyists: People registered as lobbyists and named on at least one filing in {{where}}, as its filer or as a firm's agent, each counted once. Firms and other lobbyist entities are counted separately.
overview.defPaid: Sum of what clients reported paying lobbyists and firms in {{where}}. For in-house staff this is the share of salary the employer allocated to lobbying, not total pay.
overview.chartHint: What clients reported paying in each two-year session. Select a bar to switch sessions.
overview.topBillsHint: Ranked by the number of organizations that reported lobbying on the bill.

billList.sortHint: select a column heading to sort
billList.title: Title

clients.paidNote: Reported paid is what the client reported paying its lobbyists and firms across the session, for all bills. For in-house staff it is the share of salary allocated to lobbying.

firmList.dashNote: — in Clients represented or Activities means registered, but with no disclosures of their own in the sessions shown (usually an entity files for them). 0 means they filed disclosures but reported no clients or activities.
firmList.dashTitle: No disclosures of their own in the sessions shown

bill.searchSos: Search this bill on the SoS portal ↗︎
bill.orgsDetail: reported lobbying on this bill, in {{filings}} by {{filers}}.
bill.orgCountNote: Each organization is counted once, by the position its lobbyists reported in their latest six-month filing. Organizations whose lobbyists reported more than one position in that filing are shown in purple.
bill.orgsHint: Select an organization to see who filed for it.

client.noClientKind: Not an organization: activities whose lobbyists reported no client
client.paidNote: Total of what the client reported paying its lobbyists and firms in {{where}}, for all bills. For in-house staff this is the share of salary allocated to lobbying.
client.billsHint: One row per bill. Select a bill to see which lobbyists reported on it.

errors.unavailable: Failed to get document because the server is not available.
